snippet.title: Foreign Rim - Trailer
snippet.description:
Foreign Rim is an old-school Turn-Based Strategy indie game focused on large-scale battles, complex mechanics and tactical freedom.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3553030
Discord: https://discord.gg/jfNSDhSp
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/foreignrim

Command massive armies, manage logistics, and adapt your strategy with flexible upgrades or complex management. Fight against AI or other players in PvP, play a story-driven campaign, or create your own scenarios with built-in editors!

Featuring crossplay across PC and mobile platforms, Foreign Rim brings classic strategy gameplay to modern devices.

#gaming #indiegame #turnbased
